caption:
Swipe to see 2,977 drones light up New York Harbor tonight, one for every life lost on 9/11 ✈️

The 24 years when the memorial stayed at ground level, the moment 2,977 drone lights rose over the harbor one per victim, what the exact count took, standing at the harbor and counting each light as one person, the same sky above New York 25 years apart, and what precision at this scale means for any business trying to reach every customer individually

Every year the tribute felt smaller than the loss. Tonight those numbers finally matched. 2,977 individually programmed drones flew over New York Harbor, one per confirmed 9/11 victim, on the 25th anniversary.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: Massimo on X
